heard: Flopping has been a technical foul in the NBA since 2023, but NBC Sports calls the enforcement inconsistent at best. Now the NBA has posted a video of last season's flops and says refs will call more technicals. The test is STEM, secondary, theatrical, exaggerated movement, but there's a catch. The NBA is also cracking down on push -offs. Thundercoach Mark Danyos says if defenders know that, they might be just floating off the fouling to try to beat those calls. A head snap isn't a flop. Neither is Pascal Siakoum sitting down after a jumper. Reacting to contact is legal. Selling it costs a technical foul and a free throw.
